units: moves in ATR of the candle's own timeframe (ATR14 through the previous candle); pts = index points; 'matched' = all candles of the same instrument, timeframe, time of day, trend, volatility regime and colour

families.name: Doji
families.definition: body <= 10% of the range: open and close almost equal
families.mechanism_hypothesis: buyers and sellers ended even inside the candle: a pause or indecision, not a direction
families.signal_source: the index candle (NIFTY / BANKNIFTY / SENSEX spot)
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Dragonfly doji
families.definition: doji with a lower wick >= 60% and almost no upper wick
families.mechanism_hypothesis: sellers pushed down, buyers bought it all back to the open: demand below (a rejection of lower prices)
families.signal_source: the index candle (NIFTY / BANKNIFTY / SENSEX spot)
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Gravestone doji
families.definition: doji with an upper wick >= 60% and almost no lower wick
families.mechanism_hypothesis: buyers pushed up, sellers sold it all back to the open: supply above
families.signal_source: the index candle (NIFTY / BANKNIFTY / SENSEX spot)
families.verdict: 2 instrument/timeframe finding(s), more down than matched candles; 0 held out of sample

families.name: Long-legged doji
families.definition: doji with both wicks >= 30% and range >= 1 ATR
families.mechanism_hypothesis: a wide two-way fight that ended even: high uncertainty, often around news or a level
families.signal_source: the index candle (NIFTY / BANKNIFTY / SENSEX spot)
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Spinning top
